'''Maltok ''' was the name of a [[nekghoul]] living on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] around [[3642 BBY]], when he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an individual affiliated with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Maltok appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a world boss on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be [[Death/Legends|killed]] by any Imperial character for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
